title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, ELP act on Ratnadeep Retail ₹400 crore+ IPO
description: Ratnadeep Retail Limited has filed a draft red herring prospectus to raise an amount aggregating up to ₹400 crore via fresh issue and an Offer for Sale of up to 14,860,000 Equity Shares bearing face value of ₹1 each.Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas is advising Ratnadeep Retail, the promoter and the selling shareholders on this IPO.The transaction was led by Ravi Dubey (Partner, Regional Co-Head - Capital Markets - West) and Gayathri Ramachandran (Partner), with support from Vartika Bhatnagar (Senior As
